change_summary: Repointed iborrowdesk_data_source API_URL from the dead apex host to www.iborrowdesk.com, restoring the frozen PIT borrow archive (10/10 blocked pair short-side tickers refreshed through 2026-08-24, +2843 rows total) after ~34 days of silent RemoteDisconnected aborts.
changed_variable: iborrowdesk_data_source API host (apex vs www) feeding the PIT borrow archive and pair forward-readiness borrow evidence
hypothesis: Genuine upstream fault recovery: the iBorrowDesk borrow-economics archive fetch pipeline has been fully broken since ~2026-07-21 by an upstream host change (apex iborrowdesk.com now drops /api requests with empty replies after moving to www.iborrowdesk.com), so every daily refresh aborts with RemoteDisconnected and the PIT borrow archive is frozen; repairing API_URL to the www host restores the pipeline and unstarves the news-propagation pair forward-readiness borrow gate that currently fail-closes every batch on stale_pit_borrow.
notes: Fault: upstream moved to www; apex drops /api with empty replies (probe: apex RemoteDisconnected, www 200). Repair: one-line API_URL change; 5 unit tests pass. Verification: targeted refresh of the 10 blocked pair short-side tickers 10/10 succeeded (+263 rows, all archived through 2026-08-24), standard 150-shard added +2580 rows across 89 tickers before hitting www rate limit http_444 (~90 req at 1 req/s); abort-early is resumable by design. Residual gaps recorded for the readiness lane owner: (1) 7 microcap short-side tickers (AIEV,AIIO,BINI,ECDA,FFAI,FLYE,HWEP) are covered by iBorrowDesk (www returns 200) but absent from build_default_refresh_universe, so missing_pit_borrow persists until batch tickers are fetched; (2) even a healthy cadence (~90-150/day over 1365 tickers, min_age 5d) cannot guarantee the readiness contract 3-calendar-day freshness for arbitrary batch tickers - needs targeted daily fetch of active batch short-side tickers or a contract decision; (3) cross_side_ticker_overlap blocker is data-driven and untouched. No signal, sizing, exit, order, or trade behavior changed; trade_enabled=false.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not burn further IDs on host/UA/retry-parameter tweaks for this fetcher; the host repoint is the complete fix. Do not widen build_default_refresh_universe or relax the readiness 3-calendar-day borrow freshness contract without an explicit decision by the pair-readiness lane owner; do not reinterpret stale pre-outage rows as fresh evidence.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Daily run.py Step 1.65 shards resume automatically; measurement_ready batches now depend on the remaining readiness blockers (batch-ticker fetch coverage/cadence and cross-side overlap), tracked in docs/v2/backlog.md.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The upstream site migrated to the www host; the apex host kept accepting TCP but closed /api connections without a response, so every retry path (RemoteDisconnected is not an HTTPError) exhausted and the daily 5-consecutive-failure abort fired on every run from ~2026-07-21, freezing the archive while fetch_state kept stale ok tags from earlier successes. The one-line host repoint restored 10/10 targeted fetches and a normal shard immediately.
